Horizon Android 0.7.7, an unofficial Minecraft Java 26.3 Rust client, by Vasysik and Horizon contributors.
Source and corresponding release: https://github.com/Vasysik/horizon-android/tree/v0.7.7
The Java adapter has been modified to isolate Aerix's application data.
Native libraries and generated engine tables are extracted from official release APKs during the build;
the exact upstream APK SHA-256 values are pinned in tools/prepare_horizon.py. The Rust game is not
Mojang/Microsoft software. LICENSE.txt and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md accompany the distribution.
